title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PartyPrivacyProfile
description: A Party Privacy Profile represents the set of Privacy settings defined for a Party (TM Forum TMF644 Privacy 5.0.0, OpenAPI component PartyPrivacyProfile; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PartyPrivacyProfile:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PartyPrivacyProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF644_Privacy/blob/v5.0.0/TMF644-Privacy-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'PartyPrivacyProfile' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF644_Privacy/blob/v5.0.0/TMF644-Privacy-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships
